provenance.note: R7: native_flash.py copies the delivered executable (no suffix) to {install}, chmod +x, and prints 'Serial# = native-<hostname>'; native_dump.py copies {install} back to {readback}. Both scripts are pinned in the input package (bench/), written in DEVELOPMENT.

notes: Native Linux x86_64 host, no hardware. Relative paths only: run from the campaign root. fprime-gds launches the executable itself (--app) and the deployment's Drv.TcpClient connects to the GDS server on 127.0.0.1:50000. No reset row: the plan acknowledges L3 as not covered.
